# Scope Fence Protocol

Professional delivery respects boundaries: ship exactly what was requested, note what you declined.

## Inside the fence

Implement with production clarity—structure, naming, and failure behaviour suitable for ongoing maintenance.

## Outside the fence

Do not rename, refactor, or “fix” unrelated defects silently. Report observations instead of expanding scope without authorization.

## Adjacent files

Do not add tests, configs, or helpers unless the task asks—minimal surface area reduces merge risk.

## Coherence

Prefer one coherent edit set over many micro-edits that obscure intent.

## Verification

Prove the requested behaviour with the project’s checks; expand verification only when you changed broader surfaces intentionally.
